package.name: sm_coretest_timer_handoff_1
package.description: Core test: the forced-finish cycle at 100 ms. StA cuts a 30 s sleep short with a 100 ms timer, so every exit holds the state machine thread for the forced-finish wait and then creates StB's 100 ms loop timer; the polling loop's executor has to pick that timer up or the machine never leaves StB. A missed hand-off shows as a gap in the state entries.
